summary: Precorneal tear film and lid-margin menisci; the wet surface that makes the corneal reflex and the glassy strip along the lower lid.

thickness.note: Total precorneal film (lipid 40-100 nm plus aqueous-mucin). King-Smith et al., Curr Eye Res 29:357 (2004).

lower_meniscus_height.note: Central lower tear meniscus height (TMH). Slit lamp 0.21-0.26, SS-OCT about 0.33; no age change. Imamura et al., Int Ophthalmol 38:679 (2018); Borselli et al., Diagnostics 14:316 (2024).

upper_meniscus_height.note: Central upper tear meniscus height. Borselli et al. (2024).

meniscus_taper.note: Meniscus height 3 mm from the centre relative to the central height; applied as taper^(|x| / 3 mm). Imamura (2018) gives only the direction; value fitted to the reference photo (band about 0.21 mm at x 6.1). Render-calibrated.

lower_meniscus_radius.note: Radius of the concave fillet; r ~ h for a meniscus filling a ~90 deg lid-globe angle (Yokoi et al., Br J Ophthalmol 83:92, 1999). Low confidence.

upper_meniscus_radius.note: As the lower radius: r ~ h. Low confidence.

irregularity_scale.note: Spatial scale of the surface slope noise used with surface_irregularity. Render-calibrated.

discharge_band_width.note: How far from the lower lid margin discharge strands spread at full amount. Render-calibrated (low).

refractive_index.note: Craig et al., Optom Vis Sci 72:718 (1995).

normal_reflectance.note: Fresnel reflectance at normal incidence, ((n-1)/(n+1))^2 = 0.0208. Schlick F0 for the corneal reflex and menisci. Hard lower bound is wide so a case may dilute the corneal reflex for display; the physical value stays 0.0208.

surface_irregularity.note: RMS slope error of the tear surface (break-up, epithelial oedema); roughens the reflex and meniscus glint. Render-calibrated.

discharge.note: Mucopurulent discharge: strands in the lower tear meniscus and a pool in the lower medial angle; a cloudy diffuser on the tear film. 0 in a healthy eye; watery discharge stays 0.

discharge_albedo.note: Linear albedo of mucopus (mucus, neutrophils and debris): cream to yellow-white. Render-calibrated (low).

provenance.source: King-Smith et al., Curr Eye Res 29:357 (2004); Craig et al., Optom Vis Sci 72:718 (1995); Imamura et al., Int Ophthalmol 38:679 (2018); Borselli et al., Diagnostics 14:316 (2024); Yokoi et al., Br J Ophthalmol 83:92 (1999). Taper, radius and irregularity are render-calibrated.
